info.title: Almira API
info.description: Provider-neutral application file storage management and data API.

parameters.name: include_deleted
parameters.description: Include entries still inside their recycle window. Not accepted with builder subject context.

parameters.name: metadata_key
parameters.description: Customer metadata key. Must be supplied together with metadata_value.

parameters.name: metadata_value
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON scalar (boolean, integer, or string). Must be supplied together with metadata_key.

parameters.name: extraction_kind
parameters.description: Exact extraction kind. Must be supplied together with extraction_state.

parameters.name: extraction_state
parameters.description: Exact extraction state. Must be supplied together with extraction_kind.

200.description: Deterministic keyset page.

post.description: Searches the authorized collection through a rebuildable Lodestone projection, then revision-checks every returned hit against PostgreSQL. Builder-subject calls are admitted and policy-checked before and after the remote read.

200.description: Current authorized hits. Search lag can reduce recall but cannot bypass current lifecycle, generation, metadata, project, environment, safety, or policy authority.

get.description: Returns non-secret protocol, scope, ceiling, and current revision material. A registered workload can cache this response and sign many short-lived browser capabilities locally; it refreshes after a stale-token refusal rather than calling Almira for every file access.

200.description: Current local signing configuration; never includes private key material.

customerWorkload.name: Authorization
customerWorkload.description: MetamorphWorkload followed by the canonical base64url workload-session artifact.

TenantId.name: x-almira-tenant-id
TenantId.description: Routing scope only; never authority without authenticated actor evidence and an Authorization decision.

Forbidden.description: Exact operation or scope is not authorized.

NotFound.description: Resource is absent or not revealable.

Conflict.description: Idempotency, revision, path, or lifecycle conflict.

Gone.description: Transfer is expired or definitively aborted.

Unavailable.description: A required dependency or storage binding is unavailable.

vector_indexing.description: Projects opted-in extracted content into the configured Lodestone vector field. Requires content=true.

FileMetadataFilter.description: metadata_key and metadata_value, and extraction_kind and extraction_state, are each supplied as a pair. Minimum bounds cannot exceed maximum bounds.

public_key.description: Canonical unpadded base64url Ed25519 public key; private keys are never accepted.

signature_context_base64url.description: Canonical unpadded base64url bytes prepended to canonical JCS claims before Ed25519 signing.
